name: lend-pulse
description: Read-only Bonzo lending position monitor for Hedera testnet, with risk snapshots anchored to Hedera Consensus Service (HCS) for a verifiable audit history.

steps.text: This template reads Bonzo Finance lending data directly from its deployed contracts on Hedera testnet, and lets you anchor a point-in-time risk snapshot to HCS. Bonzo's lending pools are currently paused following a July 2026 oracle exploit, so live positions will show as empty — the read path still works and is demonstrated against real, deployed contracts.

steps.label: Fund a Hedera testnet account with free HBAR
Copy the environment file and fill in your operator credentials
steps.text: Copy packages/nextjs/.env.example to packages/nextjs/.env.local and set HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID and HEDERA_OPERATOR_KEY.

steps.label: Create your own HCS topic for snapshots
Add the printed Topic ID to your .env.local
steps.text: Set HEDERA_TOPIC_ID to the topic ID printed by the previous step.
Paste any Hedera EVM wallet address to view its Bonzo position, or use your connected wallet. Click Record Snapshot to anchor the current risk data to HCS.
